Then each precursor may be further broken down using next template, etc., until we have 5 levels (reactions). At the end, leaf nodes are simple molecules (maybe commercially available). We don't need to verify buyability, just propose route.

We need to ensure each step uses the specified template ID in order. So we need a chain of 5 reactions, each applying next template to each precursor? Probably a linear route: each reaction takes one precursor from previous step and applies next template, producing new precursors, etc. Could be branching but at least 5 reactions total.

Simplify: Choose one precursor from first step, then apply second template to that precursor, get new precursors, etc.
